title: Nutty Herbal Greek Walnuts Stew
description: A hearty, protein-rich Greek-inspired stew featuring lentils, chickpeas, and crunchy walnuts, seasoned with a bhuna of aromatic herbs and spices for depth and comfort.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion turns translucent and edges start to brown, creating a bhuna.
Stir in cumin, coriander, oregano, thyme, and bay leaf; cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, until it darkens slightly and loses its raw taste, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth, then add the cooked lentils and chickpeas; bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Add the chopped walnuts, stir well, and simmer uncovered for an additional 5 minutes so the nuts soften slightly.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste; remove the bay leaf.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
